column1: # What the mod has learned about game addresses (ARM9 RAM, US ROM).
# kind: func = function entry (name shows in work/decomp/slim/ as name_<addr>),
#       site = an instruction the mod patches or hooks, data = a RAM word or table.
# Names are ours, not the game's. "itcm" = runs from ITCM, not in the decompile.
# Add a line whenever a session pins something down, then run scripts/slim_decomp.py.

column4: note

gives texture banks back to the CPU (VRAMCNT = 0x80) before the game's own uploads; the vblank interrupt's upload queue does so at lines 192 to about 209 and maps them back (0x02003cd4), cutting any upload of the mod's still running (ticket 41)
